_comment: Known high/critical advisories in the services' SHIPPED Java dependencies, accepted as a backlog so CI can gate NEW ones. Debt to burn down, not an allowlist to grow: every entry needs a line in _reasons. Regenerate with: node ci/java-dependency-audit.mjs --update

_reasons.GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26: bcprov-jdk18on 1.84 (kelta-auth, via the SAML/OpenSAML stack). Fixed in 1.85; upgrading is a dependency override on kelta-auth that needs its SAML/federation tests — tracked as a follow-up to the PR that added this gate.
_reasons.GHSA-qp49-qgx5-5m26: Same artifact and fix as GHSA-9pwp-9qqc-pr26 (bcprov-jdk18on >= 1.85).
_reasons.GHSA-hf6x-8p5f-cgmf: httpcore5 5.3.6, managed by Spring Boot 4.0.9 (kelta-auth, kelta-worker). Fixed in 5.4.3; overriding a Boot-managed version needs the worker/auth HTTP client paths re-tested — follow-up, or taken with the next Spring Boot patch that moves it.
_reasons.GHSA-v3jc-474w-2wm6: httpcore5-h2 5.3.6 — same origin and fix as GHSA-hf6x-8p5f-cgmf (>= 5.4.3).
